comparison.objective: Disassemble take-apart kitchen shears and leave both halves flat in a washing tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Rotate two halves until a keyed pivot aligns, separate them axially, and handle only molded grips.
comparison.success_condition: Both halves remain independently separated, supported and released; full credit requires both lying flat inside the tray.
comparison.reason: Keyed-pivot alignment and disassembly do not test setting an adjustable limit, locking it with opposing tools, or verifying retained motion.
